enable_contract.entry_pgood: TPS26630 core PGOOD pin16 -> C_PGOOD -> LM70660 pin9
enable_contract.remove_existing_entry_pullup: Remove core entry R9 10k from C_PGOOD to IO_3V3. Do not populate it in integrated design; divider otherwise backfeeds the unpowered3V3 rail.
enable_contract.startup: PGOOD sinks EN while entry output rises. Once entry FET is enhanced and PGTH valid, PGOOD releases; protected-input divider enables buck without CPU/FPGA/ESP or5V/3V3 dependency. VIN powers internal VCC initially; BIAS changes efficiency only after5V rises.
enable_contract.boundary: C_PGOOD is an analog enable/control node, not a3V3 GPIO or independent safety permission. No other pullup or active-high source is permitted.
unqualified_states: PGOOD functional behavior below4.5V IN_SYS, during negative input and while downstream is reverse-fed is not guaranteed by the normal electrical table.
Reverse-fed5V can violate BIAS<=VIN recommendation. No output reverse-blocking device is included here.
Negative protected-input excursion must remain above-0.3V at converter pins; existing unresolved output negative clamp remains a blocker.
No automatic power return may arm machine outputs; this circuit has no machine restart latch.
